headlines.title: Kushner and Netanyahu agree U.S. general should oversee Hamas ‘demilitarization,’ source says
headlines.description: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and President Donald Trump’s son-in-law and envoy Jared Kushner on Monday agreed that the Gaza Strip’s “demilitarization” should start with a Hamas weapons handover supervised by an American military general, according to a senior Israeli official.

headlines.title: Jury in Tupac Murder Trial Set to Hear Opening Statements
headlines.description: Opening statements are set to begin Monday in the Tupac Shakur murder case, as a now 63-year-old man is tried for the 1996 killing of the rap icon. Duane “Keefe D” Davis, who authorities say was the “shot caller” in the murder, is now finally set to stand trial for one of the biggest murder mysteries as lawyers look to lay out what really happened the night Tupac was fatally shot. NBC’s Dana Griffin reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: Hayden Panettiere, 'Heroes' and 'Nashville' Actor, Dies at 36
headlines.description: Police are investigating the sudden death of Hayden Panettiere, star of TV and film, after being found unresponsive at her South Carolina home. NBC’s Steve Patterson reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: Rare Hurricane in Hawaii Destroys Homes, Knocks Out Power
headlines.description: A rare hurricane in Hawaii pummeled the Big Island and Maui over the weekend, leaving thousands without power, causing widespread damage, stranding tourists and prompting officials to issue a major disaster declaration. NBC’s Morgan Chesky reports and TODAY’s Dylan Dreyer shares the forecast.
